slack.name: Slack
slack.notes: 2019 four-colour hash. slack.com/media-kit serves files only through a Widen collection, so the Wikimedia Commons copy of the official mark was used.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.notes: Logo.svg from the official logos zip.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.notes: 01_Glyph/01_Digital RGB/03_SVG/Digital_Glyph_Green_RGB_2026.svg from the WhatsApp Brand Resource Center zip (signed CDN query string omitted).

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.notes: Sprocket path only, taken verbatim from the official colour logo (wordmark paths dropped, square viewBox set around the sprocket). Colour #FF2F00 per the current logo.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.notes: Official cloud logo (cloud with wordmark); no direct SVG download on salesforce.com; square viewBox centred on the logo.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.notes: The Shopping Bag, full colour (two greens and a white S).

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.notes: Current Stripe icon (white mark on #533AFD tile) as served by stripe.com. The brand-assets logo kit contains only the wordmark.

twilio.name: Twilio
twilio.notes: Twilio bug. Fill changed from #e31e26 to the current brand red #F22F46 (the colour twilio.com declares for its mask-icon). Official library is a login-gated Bynder portal.

zendesk.name: Zendesk
zendesk.notes: Official single-colour mark; uses currentColor. Its embedded dark-mode <style> rule was dropped since currentColor already adapts.

intercom.name: Intercom
intercom.notes: Header logomark (rounded square with bars and smile cut out) extracted verbatim from the intercom.com homepage, where it is drawn in currentColor. intercom.com/brand returns 404.

box.name: Box
box.notes: Header 'box' wordmark extracted verbatim from the box.com homepage; fill #0061D5 moved from the site CSS (.box-logo-svg) onto the path; square viewBox centred on the wordmark.

dropbox.name: Dropbox
dropbox.notes: Blue glyph (#0061FE); the white tile and its outline rects were dropped; viewBox tightened around the glyph.

airtable.name: Airtable
airtable.notes: Mark paths only (yellow/blue/red plus shadow), copied verbatim from the full logo; wordmark path dropped and a square viewBox set. airtable.com's header currently draws the mark in mono #181D26.

notion.name: Notion
notion.notes: Black-and-white 'N' cube extracted verbatim from the notion.com header; keeps its fixed black and white. The site-only white sticker halo path was dropped and the CSS-variable fill set to #000.

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.notes: Zoom app icon (blue gradient tile with white camera).

monday.name: monday.com
monday.notes: Three-shape mark (#FB275D, #FFCC00, #00CA72) referenced by monday.com; white background rect dropped; viewBox tightened (square) around the mark.
